title: A menu or category the customer deleted on live no longer orphans Tracy's new item or post
steps: Run the real MariaDB merge cases (WordPress, Joomla) and the push changeset case.
expect: A deleted category or menu the copy's new rows use stays, as a delete-modify conflict.
A deletion nothing of the copy's uses still comes over.
No new menu item is written into a menu the live site does not have and the push does not make.

tests: a category or menu the customer deleted on live stays while the copy’s new post or menu item uses it: a conflict, never an orphan (#119)
Joomla: a menu or category the customer deleted on live stays while the copy’s new item or article uses it: a conflict, never an orphan (#119)
a new menu item goes only into a menu the live site has or this push makes; never into a deleted one (#119)
